lead_raw_text:
The structure of CeMg9Al3 crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4mm (No. 143), with a 13-atom unit cell and four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements for all three elements: Ce and Al centers have 12 geometric neighbors, while Mg centers have 12 neighbors with varying Ce, Al, and Mg compositions. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 13 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis shows Mg–Mg 12-vertex coordination polyhedra sharing corners, edges, and faces, and Ce–Mg pairs sharing corners and edges.
